extDescription.message: See how your team uses ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Copilot at work, with a visible notice and a filter that stops sensitive data before it is sent.

optIntro.message: AI Insights: records how AI is used at work according to your company's policy, and warns about, redacts or blocks sensitive data before it is sent.

optCodePlaceholder.message: Paste the code from workspace › Me › AI

optNote1.message: Recorded only when you press send, and only on these AI sites: $sites$.

optNote2.message: Every AI page shows a small notice in the corner.

optNote3.message: You can see what was recorded in workspace › Me › AI.

optWhatSent.message: What this extension sends, field by field

statusExpired.message: This code is no longer valid. Create a new one in workspace.

statusBadCode.message: That code is not valid. Copy the whole code again from workspace.

noticeOn.message: AI Insights: your company records AI use on this page

noticeOff.message: workspace AI Insights is not connected

noticeWhatPrompts.message: What you send is saved to workspace so the company can see what AI helps with. Nothing is recorded until you press send.

noticeWhatBoth.message: What you send and the AI's answers are saved to workspace so the company can see what AI helps with. Nothing is recorded until you press send.

noticePolicy.message: See the policy and what was recorded

noticeConnect.message: Open the extension and paste the connection code from workspace › Me › AI.

confirmSensitive.message:
This message seems to contain $kinds$.

Sending it to an outside AI may break company rules. Send anyway?

optHint.message: Suggest the task I have open in workspace

optHintNote.message: A prompt sent within 2 hours of opening a task in workspace is suggested for that task; you confirm it in Me › AI. The extension reads only the task ID, nothing else.

optHintDenied.message: The browser did not allow the extension to read the workspace page, so suggestions are off.

noticeRedact.message: Sensitive data is redacted before sending.

noticeBlock.message: Messages with sensitive data will not be sent.

redactBody.message: Your company asks to redact $kinds$ before sending to an outside AI. This is what will be sent:

blockBody.message: This message contains $kinds$. Your company does not allow sending this kind of data to an outside AI. Remove it and send again.

linkAsk.message: Link this chat to $code$ in workspace?

statusPaused.message: Your company has switched AI Insights off. Nothing is recorded.
